title: AiSphere App Catalog Export
description: Combined catalog file written by Explore > Export in single-file mode. The $schema field points editors and validators at this schema; the schema field identifies the payload. apps contains one entry per application specification.

$schema.description: Optional self-reference to this schema, written by Explore > Export.

count.description: Number of entries in apps. Informational; validators should trust the array length.
